pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)double jump, growing with the tier, up to +1.$(li)fall protection, growing with the tier, up to +45%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.
